sentences.en: In 1960, a new wonder drug hit the U.S.
sentences.zh: 1960年，一种神奇的新药进入了美国

sentences.en: And while a lot of new drugs promised dramatic results,
sentences.zh: 虽然许多新药都承诺会有显著的疗效，

sentences.en: this one would actually transform millions of lives and radically shift American culture.
sentences.zh: 但这一种药却真正改变了数百万人的生活，并从根本上改变了美国文化。

sentences.en: It was the first oral contraceptive.
sentences.zh: 它是第一种口服避孕药。

sentences.en: Drugs, for many, seem the answer to all the probleMs.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，药物似乎是解决所有问题的答案。

sentences.en: When a government agency approves the first birth control pill in 1960,
sentences.zh: 当政府机构在1960年批准第一种避孕药时，

sentences.en: it helps set in motion forces that will soon change the social mores of the world.
sentences.zh: 它推动了即将改变世界社会习俗的力量。

sentences.en: In just two years, 1.2 million American women were taking the birth control pill.
sentences.zh: 仅仅两年内，就有120万美国女性开始服用避孕药。

sentences.en: Within five years, the pill would become the most popular form of birth control in the country.
sentences.zh: 五年内，避孕药就成为了美国最受欢迎的避孕方式。

sentences.en: It let women choose if and when they wanted to have children.
sentences.zh: 它让女性能够选择是否以及何时想要孩子。

sentences.en: It gave them more freedom to pursue careers.
sentences.zh: 它给了她们更多追求事业的自由。

sentences.en: And it helped usher in the free love era of the late 1960s.
sentences.zh: 它还帮助开启了20世纪60年代末的“自由恋爱”时代。

sentences.en: And even if you've never taken the pill, you can probably picture its packaging.
sentences.zh: 即使你从未服用过避孕药，你可能也能想象出它的包装。

sentences.en: There's the round plastic package that opens like a shell and looks kind of like a makeup compact.
sentences.zh: 有一种圆形的塑料包装，像贝壳一样打开，看起来有点像化妆粉盒。

sentences.en: There's also the more low-key rectangular pill sheets,
sentences.zh: 还有一种更低调的矩形药片板，

sentences.en: with each pill arranged in four neat rows for every day of the month.
sentences.zh: 每片药都整齐地排列成四行，对应每个月的每一天。

sentences.en: It's hard to think of other prescription drug packages
sentences.zh: 很难想到还有其他什么处方药包装

sentences.en: that are as widely recognizable as those of the birth control pill.
sentences.zh: 能像避孕药包装那样广为人知。

sentences.en: But the pill didn't always have special packaging.
sentences.zh: 但避孕药并非一开始就有特殊的包装。

sentences.en: The first birth control pill to hit the market came in a simple glass bottle of loose tablets,
sentences.zh: 第一种上市的避孕药装在简单的玻璃瓶里，药片散在里面，
就像其他任何处方药一样。

sentences.en: They come in big bottles for a year's supply.
sentences.zh: 它们装在大瓶子里，供一年使用。

sentences.en: Smaller bottles for a month's supply.
sentences.zh: 小瓶子则供一个月使用。

sentences.en: As the pill went from nondescript bottles to the iconic pill packages,
sentences.zh: 随着避孕药从不起眼的瓶子演变成标志性的药片包装，

sentences.en: it came to represent larger trends in American medicine.
sentences.zh: 它开始代表美国医学界的更大趋势。
